title: MockingBird: Context-aware Repository-level Code Translation with Isolated Validation
abstract: arXiv:2511.21878v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite advances in repository-level code translation, automated type resolution across differing type systems and translation validation (functional-equivalence checking) remain challenging. This paper proposes MockingBird, combining context-aware type resolution with mock-based isolated validation. MockingBird retrieves API documentation and contextual code information per source-language type, prompting an LLM to resolve precise cross-language type mappings, reducing the manual effort of existing approaches. Using this automatically constructed type map, MockingBird employs custom serialization/deserialization to generate equivalent target-language mock objects, validating each translation unit in isolation without test translation, eliminating test-overfitting risks and translation challenges. translated_title: MockingBird：具有隔离验证的上下文感知仓库级代码翻译
translated_abstract: 尽管仓库级代码翻译已取得进展，但跨不同类型系统的自动类型解析以及翻译验证（即功能等价性检查）仍然充满挑战。本文提出了 MockingBird，将上下文感知的类型解析与基于模拟对象的隔离验证相结合。MockingBird 为每个源语言类型检索 API 文档和上下文代码信息，通过提示大语言模型（LLM）来解析精确的跨语言类型映射，从而减少了现有方法所需的人工投入。利用这一自动构建的类型映射，MockingBird 采用自定义的序列化/反序列化方法生成等价的目标语言模拟对象，在不翻译测试的情况下对每个翻译单元进行隔离验证，消除了测试过拟合的风险和测试翻译带来的挑战。在 AlphaTrans 基准的 10 个 Java 到 Python 任务上，MockingBird 将功能等价性从最先进的 25.14% 提升至……
tldr: MockingBird 通过结合上下文感知的跨语言类型解析与基于模拟对象的隔离验证，无需翻译测试即可验证仓库级代码翻译的功能等价性，将 AlphaTrans 基准上 Java 到 Python 翻译的功能等价率从最先进的 25.14% 显著提升。
en_tdlr: MockingBird combines context-aware cross-language type resolution with mock-based isolated validation, enabling functional-equivalence checking of repository-level code translation without test translation and substantially improving upon the state-of-the-art 25.14% equivalence rate on Java-to-Python tasks.
